name: Gearbox
text: Switch to the NVIDIA H100 with Llama 3.4 70B model. This setup offers superior performance and efficiency, enhancing EXCAVA’s processing capability significantly for complex tasks. The trade-off is the initial investment and potential integration time, but the long-term gains in capability and speed far outweigh these costs.

name: Torque
text: The H100’s cost and integration risk outweigh the gains—EXCAVA’s bottleneck isn’t raw compute but data quality and model alignment. A cheaper, newer model like Llama 3.3 70B (if accessible) or a fine-tuned variant could deliver the 0.5% lift without the H100’s overhead. Test both on a controlled task: if the newer model matches or beats the H100’s output in 24 hours, it wins.
